relationships.subject: dorsal horn neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the gene encoding CB1 receptors, CNR1, but not the gene encoding CB2 receptors, CNR2, is highly expressed in dorsal horn neurons of mice

relationships.subject: superficial dorsal horn
relationships.evidence_quote: CB1 receptor immunoreactivity was significantly higher in the superficial dorsal horn compared to the deeper dorsal horn laminae for both rats and humans

relationships.subject: peptidergic CGRP afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: we qualitatively found that CB1 receptors do not co-localize with CGRP for the majority of rat SDH puncta

key_findings: CB1 is preferentially localized to the superficial dorsal horn in male and female rats and humans, with no sex difference.
CNR1 but not CNR2 is robustly expressed in dorsal horn neuron subsets, and CB1 is not primarily on CGRP peptidergic afferents.
